# Stillinger Investigations

> > Fullservice private investigation firm in South Carolina offering 50+ years of experience in personal, business, legal, and insurance investigations with court-admissible evidence and expert witness support.

Stillinger Investigations is a licensed PI firm operating across South Carolina and the Southeast with expertise in infidelity investigations, fraud detection, digital forensics, and litigation support. The team combines traditional surveillance techniques with advanced technology including TSCM counter-measures, GPS tracking, and computer forensics.
